stops.note: named the paralyzing plant poison used on hunting arrows
Walter Raleigh described poison arrows in Guiana in 1596; curare later became a surgical muscle relaxant
stops.meaning: a paralyzing poison extracted from plants

stops.note: entered English through scientific accounts, later used in medicine as a muscle relaxant
stops.meaning: a plant-derived poison used medically as a muscle relaxant

current_meaning: a toxic plant extract that causes paralysis, historically used as an arrow poison and later in medicine as a muscle relaxant
